# Fedlex test fixtures (real Swiss federal law)

Unmodified Akoma Ntoso files of the Classified Compilation (SR), downloaded on 2026-10-14 from
`https://www.fedlex.admin.ch/filestore/fedlex.data.admin.ch/eli/cc/...` (the Fedlex website's
public mapping of the linked-data file store) with the ULIS research User-Agent. Each file is
stored gzip-compressed (`*.xml.gz`) next to the fetcher's metadata (`*.xml.meta.json`: URL,
status, retrieval time), in the cache layout used by `PoliteHttp`.

| Path (under `cache/www.fedlex.admin.ch/filestore/fedlex.data.admin.ch/eli/cc/`) | Content |
|---|---|
| `1999/404/20240303/{de,fr,it}` | Federal Constitution (SR 101), consolidation of 2024-03-03 |
| `2022/491/20230901/{de,fr,it}` | Data Protection Act (SR 235.1), consolidation of 2023-09-01 |
| `2022/491/20250401/{de,fr,it}` | Data Protection Act (SR 235.1), consolidation of 2025-04-01 (Art. 24 para. 5bis inserted) |
| `1969/737_757_755/20220701/{de,fr,it}` | Administrative Procedure Act (SR 172.021), consolidation of 2022-07-01 |
| `24/233_245_233/20260701/de` | Civil Code (SR 210), consolidation of 2026-07-01, German only |

Official enactments are not protected by copyright (Art. 5 Copyright Act, SR 231.1); reuse is
subject to Art. 49 para. 1 Publications Ordinance (SR 170.512.1).
